datasets.title: Market observatory access database
datasets.description: SQLite database for the 104 Asia–Africa economies. Refreshed 2026-10-15: the published WDI snapshot (16,450 observations, 17 indicators), 21 extra annual indicators (19,616 observations) for market scale, apparel structure, employment, education, travel services, visitor arrivals and digital access, 1,647 Africa–Asia export flows for 2023–2025, and 1,410 monthly Pink Sheet prices through 2026-09. A missing trade row is not zero trade. Flows below USD 1 million are omitted.
datasets.source: World Bank WDI; UN Comtrade; World Bank Pink Sheet

fields.country: ISO3 in WDI observations; country names in curated records
fields.value: Original numeric source value; no missing-to-zero conversion
fields.unit: Indicator-specific; retained in API and exports
